text:
Rae (AE): pinging team with Sundance POC redlines. procurement wants net30, PO-before-countersign, HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2), SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, escrow for model weights after POC, and a DPA item limiting embeddings retention to 30 days. attaching redline.
Jules - Legal: quick clarifying Qs — is Sundance handling PHI/PCI or standard PII? which Redwood legal entity should execute? any multi-entity invoicing?
Rae (AE): standard PII. they want Redwood US to sign, but asked about split invoicing to a UK subsidiary for EMEA spend. procurement is insisting on an HSM-level attestation and a carveout in the indemnity for key compromise.
Marco (SE): tech note: Hosted supports customer-managed keys and we can provide procedural attestations plus SOC reports. HSM hardware attestation (FIPS/HSM certs) is only available on Dedicated with HSM-backed KMS. We cannot provide an HSM hardware cert for Hosted.
Ivy (Presales): recommend a Dedicated POC window (30d) in the EMEA region to cover HSM attestation + lower p95 latency. We can offer a short reserved capacity with a trial discount.
Noah (Finance): net30 is aggressive; Redwood standard for enterprise POCs is net45 or net60 for larger customers. Finance will accept net30 only with an approved credit check + AP contact and PO before countersign. split invoicing adds billing complexity; need tax IDs and billing addresses for each entity.
Jules - Legal: redline hotspots: (1) SLA 6 they request p95 <120ms and 99.99% during the POC (2) KMS warranty/indemnity & FIPS attestation (3) escrow for model artifacts after POC (4) DPA retention for embeddings (30 days) and subprocessor disclosure. we need subprocessors list and a data flow.
Marco (SE): p95 <120ms at non-trivial QPS realistically requires Dedicated, especially for larger models. Hosted p95 is materially higher depending on prompt size. Proposed compromise: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet latency SLOs; firm p95 latency SLAs and hardware attestations will be provided via a Dedicated deployment addendum." Also propose an automatic routing fallback clause that can route traffic to Dedicated in case of persistent latency breaches.
Jules - Legal: propose compromise language: "Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet agreed latency SLOs. If Customer requires a firm p95 latency SLA, hardware attestations, or escrow for model artifacts, parties will execute a Dedicated deployment addendum specifying the SLA, attestations, and escrow terms." Agree?
Rae (AE): Sundance also wants countersign within 2 business days and an escrow contact. procurement said they'd accept e-sign.
Noah (Finance): 2 business days is tight; finance can expedite if PO, credit check, and billing contacts are provided in advance. we need PO number on orderform for net30.
Ivy (Presales): I'll prepare a one-pager Hosted vs Dedicated for the POC with EMEA region latencies, approximate costs, and what attestation each option includes.
ContractsBot: ACTIONS 6 Legal (Jules) draft MSA response with Dedicated-addendum fallback, DPA retention language, and escrow note (ETA 1 business day); SE (Marco) attach perf matrix for Hosted vs Dedicated in EMEA and Dedicated trial pricing (ETA EOD); Sales (Rae) collect PO, AP contacts, tax IDs, and signer names (ETA today); Finance (Noah) confirm invoice flow and net30 acceptance subject to credit check (ETA EOD); Presales (Ivy) prepare Hosted vs Dedicated one-pager (ETA today).
Rae (AE): pinging Sundance procurement now, cc @Ivy to propose Dedicated trial as the path to HSM attestations. please react with :thumbsup: if you agree with the plan.
Jules - Legal: :thumbsup:
Marco (SE): :thumbsup:
Noah (Finance): :thumbsup:
Ivy (Presales): :thumbsup:
Rae (AE): thanks all 6 will post updates when PO, signers, and credit check complete.
